# Notes
# - open-logic-ft: Clone with the submodule 3rdParty/en_cl_fix (git clone --recursive); compile_order.txt lists its
#   files. 4.7.0-ft.6 adds olo_base_chunker and olo_axi_lite_decoder to 4.7.0-ft.2 (ft.3), fixes the error reporting of
#   olo_axi_master_simple and the write word count of olo_axi_master_full (ft.4), the address of transfers that
#   olo_axi_master_simple splits at AxiMaxBeats_g (ft.5), and the transfers of olo_axi_master_full with 8-bit data and
#   narrow addresses (ft.6). Every core of the catalog is verified with 4.7.0-ft.6.
# - openrmap: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library of
#   the Composer.
# - openspp: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library of
#   the Composer.
# - openfibre: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library of
#   the Composer. compile_order.txt lists the technology-independent sources; the vendor-specific physical adapter
#   ofb_pa_gty is added separately (see its notes).
# - opencrypto: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library
#   of the Composer.
# - opencompact: The submodules of the repository (open-logic, uvvm) serve its own tests; a system uses the olo library
#   of the Composer.
# - ofb_pa_gty: Vendor-specific (AMD Versal GTY). hdl/ofb_pa_gty/src/ofb_pa_gty.vhd is not in component_list.txt: add it
#   to the library openfibre, and create the transceiver wizard instance ofb_gtw in the Vivado project with
#   hdl/ofb_pa_gty/tcl/ofb_gtw.tcl (source the file, then ofb_gtw_create ofb_gtw 156.25 for a 156.25 MHz reference
#   clock).
# - ofb_pa_gty: RefClk is the output O of the IBUFDS_GTE5 of the reference clock pins of the quad; place the buffer in
#   the chip-level top, as hdl/ofb_vck190/src/ofb_vck190_top.vhd does.
# - ofb_pa_gty: Stat_TxReady reaches Phy_TxReady of the core through the Phy interface; the core holds the link in
#   Near-End Reset while the transmitters are not ready, so its reset needs no status of the adapter. The VCK190
#   reference design resets the core and the adapter with the power-on reset.
# - ofb_pa_gty: The line rate is 6.25 Gbit/s with a 156.25 MHz reference clock, so LaneClk runs at 156.25 MHz.
# - ofb_pa_gty: Simulation needs the AMD transceiver models (unisim and the simulation files of the wizard); OpenFibre
#   simulates the adapter with tools/run_xsim.py. Without them, the test bench model tb/ofb_tb_pa_model.vhd of OpenFibre
#   (two adapters joined by a lane, one clock) stands in for the adapters of both ends of a link.
# - open-logic-ft: AMD Vivado: source the script of Open Logic once. It reads the scoped constraints of
#   olo_base_cc_reset, olo_base_cc_bits, olo_base_cc_simple, olo_base_reset_gen and olo_base_ram_sdp wherever the system
#   uses them, also inside the cores. tools/vivado/all_constraints_amd.tcl would also read those of olo_intf_sync, which
#   expect device pins at its input and stop the build (ERROR 18-513) where a block synchronises internal signals with
#   it, as ofb_pa_gty does; a block that synchronises device pins declares its own false path for them. File
#   src/base/tcl/olo_base_constraints_amd.tcl.
